title: Muir Woods National Monument Brochure Trail Map 1974 National Park Service
condition_description: Vintage 1974 National Park Service brochure. Clean, with normal fold lines; no writing.
description:
Vintage Muir Woods National Monument, California visitor brochure and trail map from the National Park Service, U.S. Department of the Interior.

- GPO 1974-543-530/84, Reprint 1974; map revised Dec 1973
- Fold-out trail map of Redwood Canyon: Bootjack, Ben Johnson, Dipsea, Hillside and Fern Creek trails, Cathedral Grove, Bohemian Grove, Kent and Pinchot memorials, visitor center
- Inset map of Mt. Tamalpais State Park, Stinson Beach and Muir Beach
- Text on the redwoods, plants, animal life, the park's naming for John Muir, and "We're Joining the Metric World" with a kilometers-to-miles chart

Condition: clean, with normal fold lines and no writing (see photos).

Please see all photos - they are part of the description.
